newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Aeropostale names head of air transport ops..
newsitem.headline: L'Aeropostale names head of air transport ops..

text.p: French airline L'Aeropostale, said it has appointed Patrick Fourticq as director, air transport operations.
Fourticq joins L'Aeropostale from Air France's Africa-Middle East division, where he held a senior management position.
He replaces Paul Groussard who is take up other responsibilities within the Air France group, L'Aeropostale said.
L'Aeropostale is 50 percent-owned by La Poste (of which 10 percent belongs to its express distribution subsidiary, Chronopost) while the Air France group has a 50 percent shareholding.
